column4: PR #4364: test-only package: the multi-process cross-replica PostgreSQL race harness; every file carries `//go:build e2e` except fuzz_noe2e_test.go (`//go:build !e2e` fuzz-target stubs so the targets are listable without tags), which is what makes `go list ./...` see this directory; no non-test code and nothing imported by the production binaries
